questions.stem: An Azure SQL Database must be available in Fabric for analytics with low latency, without building a pipeline. What does mirroring do?

options.text: Continuously replicates the data into OneLake as Delta tables, and creates a SQL analytics endpoint to query them
Sends every change to an eventstream, which you then route into an eventhouse table
Creates a shortcut that reads the Azure SQL Database live on every query, so nothing lands in OneLake
Copies the database once into a warehouse, and leaves later changes to a scheduled pipeline

questions.explanation: Mirroring continuously replicates data into OneLake, converting it to Delta, and creates a SQL analytics endpoint for the mirrored data.

questions.stem: How fast can mirroring publish changes from the source?

options.text: Once a day, when the capacity's nightly maintenance window runs
Only when someone selects Refresh on the mirrored database
Once an hour, on the mirrored database's refresh schedule

questions.explanation: Changes can be published as fast as every 15 seconds.

questions.stem: Which two statements about mirroring costs are true?

options.text: Replication runs as a Spark job that consumes the capacity's CUs
Mirroring storage is always billed as OneLake storage from the first gigabyte
Each capacity unit you buy comes with a free terabyte of mirroring storage
The background compute that replicates data into OneLake is free and doesn't use capacity

questions.explanation: Background Fabric compute used to replicate data is free and doesn't consume capacity, and an F64, for example, gets 64 TB of mirroring storage free.

questions.stem: An in-house application wants to write its own change data straight into a mirrored database in Fabric. What's that called?

options.text: Database mirroring from Azure SQL Database
A OneLake shortcut to the application's database

questions.explanation: Open mirroring lets any developer write their application's change data directly into a mirrored database item, based on the open Delta Lake format and public APIs. Metadata mirroring syncs catalog metadata only.
